name: transcribe_audio
description: Uploads a local audio or video file to FreeAudioToText for transcription. Supported formats: MP3, M4A, WAV, MP4, MOV, etc. Returns a job_id.

file_path.description: Absolute local path to the audio or video file (e.g., /Users/name/Downloads/audio.mp3)

name: transcribe_from_url
description: Submits a YouTube or TikTok URL to FreeAudioToText for transcription. Returns a job_id.

youtube_url.description: The full URL of the YouTube or TikTok video.

name: get_job_status
description: Checks the status of a transcription job using its job_id. Use this to poll until status is 'completed'.

job_id.description: The unique job_id returned by transcribe_audio or transcribe_from_url.

name: get_transcript
description: Retrieves the full text transcript for a completed job, including speaker labels (diarization).

job_id.description: The unique job_id of the completed transcription job.

name: generate_ai_report
description: Generates a deep AI structural analysis report (Summary, Action Items, Outline, or Speakers) for a completed transcript.

job_id.description: The unique job_id of the completed transcription job.

type.description: The type of analysis report to generate.
